description: Single-DGX-Spark Qwen3.8-27B on Ash Hart's TensorFold engine v0.6.6 (exact decoding, custom CUDA kernels JIT-compiled on first start, stock upstream source) with NVIDIA's ModelOpt NVFP4 export (NVFP4 MLP and language-model head, FP8 attention and DeltaNet projections, bf16 embeddings and gates) read as it ships, and z-lab's DFlash2 draft model, which TensorFold's CUDA engine requires unless drafting is switched off. One rank only: TensorFold's two-rank mode is not available here. Serves one request at a time by default (upstream CUDA default; the concurrency setting enables shared rounds) at the model's 262,144-token window. Text only: upstream stops at startup on --vision for this checkpoint until image input is qualified on it. Upstream measured 47 tok/s code and 38 tok/s chat on one DGX Spark (below its MLX 4-bit checkpoint's 58 and 50 on the same box) and a 62.5 GiB startup estimate at the 262,144-token window (upstream claims, unmeasured here). Licences, for information: Qwen3.8-27B and NVIDIA's NVFP4 export are Apache-2.0; z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 states Apache-2.0 on its model card (a mirror of incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2); TensorFold is Apache-2.0 from 0.6.0 (MIT up to 0.5.0). TensorFold v0.6.6 at cb2ebf0540f42604e2759b2ddef497861e928248, the newest release of TensorFold's Python engine line (0.6; TensorFold 1.x is a native binary that serves only Nemotron on CUDA), keeps every option this recipe passes. Per upstream's release notes it runs CUDA prompts at bf16 by default and serves Prometheus /metrics (opt-in --prefill-fp8 and --checkpoint-slots exist but are not exposed here); the existing context bound, KV/drafting defaults, and one-stream resource profile are retained. From 0.6.1 to 0.6.6 upstream's release notes add, among others, the Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages), optional API keys (not set here), /v1/decisions scoring and joint prefill of prompts that wait together when concurrency is above 1. Since 0.6.1 an NVFP4 checkpoint runs the 4-bit activations it names by default, as vLLM does (--precision full, 16-bit activations against the same weights, is not exposed here); replies still equal this engine's own serial decoding (upstream claim). The pinned ARM64 image includes xgrammar 0.2.8 and Apache TVM FFI 0.1.11 for OpenAI response_format structured-output requests. Thinking is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: Open a think block by default (upstream default: --thinking).
title: Qwen3.8 27B NVFP4 TensorFold single Spark
